131047.title: 24-hour reply window closed
131047.detail: This person last messaged you more than 24 hours ago, so WhatsApp no longer allows a free-form reply. Send an approved template to re-open the conversation.

131026.title: Message undeliverable
131026.detail: WhatsApp could not deliver to this number — it may not be on WhatsApp, may have been typed wrongly, or the person has never accepted messages from this business.

131049.title: Held back by WhatsApp
131049.detail: WhatsApp limits how many marketing messages one person receives. Nothing is broken — try again later, or use a utility template if the message is transactional.

130472.title: Excluded by a WhatsApp experiment
130472.detail: This number is in a Meta experiment group that does not receive marketing messages. Utility and authentication templates are unaffected.

131021.title: Cannot message this number
131021.detail: The recipient is the same as the sender, or the number cannot receive messages from this account.

131051.title: Unsupported message type
131051.detail: WhatsApp does not accept this kind of message on this account.

131052.title: Media could not be downloaded
131052.detail: WhatsApp could not fetch the attachment from its URL. Check the file is still public and re-send.

131053.title: Media could not be uploaded
131053.detail: WhatsApp rejected the attachment — usually the format or the file size. Re-send it as a supported type under the size limit.

131042.title: Billing problem on the WhatsApp account
131042.detail: Meta has no working payment method for this WhatsApp Business Account, so every message on this number is being refused. Fix the card in WhatsApp Manager → Billing.

131031.title: WhatsApp account restricted
131031.detail: Meta has locked or restricted this WhatsApp Business Account, usually for a policy or quality reason. Check the account quality page in WhatsApp Manager.

131045.title: Number not registered correctly
131045.detail: This WhatsApp number is not fully registered with Meta, or its certificate is wrong. Re-register it in Settings → WhatsApp.

133010.title: Number not registered
133010.detail: This WhatsApp number has not completed registration with Meta and cannot send anything yet.

190.title: WhatsApp access token expired
190.detail: The Meta access token for this institute is no longer valid, so no message can be sent. Update it in Settings → WhatsApp.

368.title: Account temporarily blocked
368.detail: Meta has temporarily blocked this account for policy reasons. Sending resumes only once the block expires or is appealed.

132000.title: Wrong number of template values
132000.detail: The template was filled with a different number of values than it has placeholders.

132001.title: Template not found
132001.detail: No approved template with this name and language exists on the account. Sync templates, or pick another one.

132005.title: Template text too long
132005.detail: The filled-in template exceeds the length WhatsApp allows. Shorten the values.

132007.title: Template content rejected
132007.detail: The values broke WhatsApp’s formatting rules — usually a newline, a tab, or four spaces in a row inside a placeholder.

132012.title: Template value format mismatch
132012.detail: One of the values does not match the format the template was approved with.

132015.title: Template paused for low quality
132015.detail: WhatsApp paused this template because recipients marked it as unwanted. Use a different template until it recovers.

132016.title: Template disabled
132016.detail: WhatsApp permanently disabled this template for quality reasons. It cannot be used again.

rateLimit.title: Rate limit reached
rateLimit.detail: This account has hit its WhatsApp request limit. Wait a few minutes and retry.

131056.title: Too many messages to this person
131056.detail: WhatsApp throttled the number of messages between this account and this recipient. Try again later.

outOfCredits.title: Out of WhatsApp credits
outOfCredits.detail: The messaging account has run out of credits. Top it up with the provider before sending again.

sessionWindowClosed.title: 24-hour reply window closed
sessionWindowClosed.detail: This person last messaged you more than 24 hours ago, so only an approved template can reach them now.

timedOut.title: The request timed out
timedOut.detail: The server took too long to answer. Try again.

couldNotReachServer: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this inbox
noAccess.detail: Your session may have expired — reload the page and sign in again.

conversationGone: The server does not have this conversation any more.

fileTooLarge.title: That file is too large
fileTooLarge.detail: WhatsApp rejects attachments over its size limit.

tooManyRequests.title: Too many requests
tooManyRequests.detail: Slow down for a moment, then try again.

serverError: The server returned an error ({{status}}). Try again in a moment.
